title: A simple method to increase the proportion of bone marrow-derived macrophages positive for M-CSFR using the reducing agent dithiothreitol (DTT)
author: Hashimoto, Daida, et al.

steps.title: Harvest bone marrow cells
steps.instruction: Euthanize male C57Bl/6 mice (Charles River Laboratories Japan, Kanagawa) by cervical dislocation and collect bone marrow cells from tibiae and femora.

steps.title: Culture bone marrow adherent macrophages
steps.instruction: Plate the harvested bone marrow cells in RPMI 1640 (Invitrogen) supplemented with 20 % fetal bovine serum (Equitech‑Bio, Texas) and incubate at 37 °C in a humidified atmosphere of 5 % CO₂/95 % air for 14 days, changing medium regularly and discarding floating cells to retain adherent cells.

steps.title: Confirm macrophage identity via Ac‑LDL uptake
steps.instruction: Treat adherent cells with 400 ng/mL acetylated LDL (Ac‑LDL; Biomedical Technologies, Inc., Madrid) labeled with 3,3′‑dioctadecyloxacarbocyanine perchlorate (Dio) for 4 h at 37 °C, then detach cells, block Fc receptors with Miltenyi Biotec FcR blocking reagent for 10 min on ice (4 °C), stain with PE‑conjugated anti‑M‑CSFR antibody (Miltenyi Biotec) for 10 min on ice, wash, and analyse by flow cytometry on a BD FACSCalibur (Becton‑Dickinson).

steps.title: Treat cells with DTT or controls
steps.instruction: Incubate cultured adherent cells with the indicated reagent in complete medium:

substeps.instruction: DTT: add dithiothreitol to a final concentration of 1 mM and treat for 1 h, 4 h, or 24 h.
2‑Mercaptoethanol: add 2‑ME to 1 mM and treat for 24 h.
Tunicamycin: add tunicamycin to 0.5 mg/mL and treat for 24 h.
Vehicle control: add the appropriate solvent for the same duration as each treatment.

steps.title: Incubate with Dio‑labeled Ac‑LDL
steps.instruction: After the reagent treatment, incubate the cells with 400 ng/mL Dio‑conjugated Ac‑LDL for 4 h at 37 °C.

steps.title: Block Fc receptors and stain for M‑CSFR
steps.instruction: Detach the cells, block Fc receptors with Miltenyi Biotec FcR blocking reagent for 10 min at 4 °C, then stain with PE‑conjugated anti‑M‑CSFR antibody (Miltenyi Biotec) for 10 min at 4 °C, wash the cells with PBS, and keep on ice until analysis.

steps.title: Analyze cells by flow cytometry
steps.instruction: Run the stained cells on a BD FACSCalibur flow cytometer, acquiring fluorescence for PE (M‑CSFR) and FITC (F4/80 if used) and record the percentage of M‑CSFR‑positive macrophages.
